provision_network: bridge; public resolved npm registry data only; no lifecycle scripts
provision_script:
set -eu
mkdir -p /home/node/work/wxyc-shared
tar -xzf /tmp/source.tar.gz --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner -C /home/node/work/wxyc-shared
cd /home/node/work/wxyc-shared
node --version
npm --version
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
offline_build_script:
set -eu
cd /home/node/work/wxyc-shared
node --version
npm --version
npm run generate:typescript
npm run build
npm pack --json
acceptance: Use archive only if complete SHA512 equals unchanged backend lock integrity. Any failure/mismatch ends attempt without variants.
